notes.title: MAJOR Demo Update, Play the New Version Now!
notes.content:
What's new in the demo?
It’s been over a year since the last demo update – and in that time, the game has grown tremendously. While the full version now includes all realms and bosses, the demo still focuses on the Nature Realm, just like before… but everything around it has leveled up.

Here’s a breakdown of some major changes:
[hr][/hr]
🔧 Massive UI Overhaul
The interface has been almost completely redesigned to be cleaner, more readable, and easier to navigate. It’s still being polished, but it already feels like a huge step forward.

⚔️ Combat Feels Better Than Ever
Enemy telegraphs are now much more readable: enemies slow down before attacking, and new ground indicators make danger zones clear. The result? Combat is way more fun and satisfying (and yes — we’ll keep refining it!).

🌀 Reworked Character Abilities
All characters still use their classic tap and charge attacks, but their behaviors have been adjusted for better balance and more dynamic fights.

🌄 Major Visual Upgrade
Every realm now features lighting and shadows to bring environments to life — all while staying true to the retro PSX-style aesthetic.

👾 More Enemy Variety
Across all realms, enemy variety has been greatly expanded. (Note: this is mostly visible in the full version, we felt that the Nature Realm had enough enemy variety)
[hr][/hr]
Honestly, there have been so many changes over the past year, I’ve probably forgotten more than half of them… but I hope you’ll feel the difference the moment you jump in.

If you played the old demo — this is a whole new experience. And if you’re new — there’s never been a better time to try it.

Thanks for your support, as always!

P.S. I'll be sharing a pre-release roadmap in the next few days, so you can see exactly what we’re working on as we get closer to release. Stay tuned! 😊

notes.title: Minor demo update
notes.content: All three characters are permanently unlocked for ease of use in the demo.
